source.timeframe: -24h (2026-10-11T11:00Z → 2026-10-12T11:00Z; wider peak-inclusive window per §11 R1, vs ISI-5684's 3h)
source.timeframeNotes: 24h peak-inclusive window on a shared demo playground (wider than ISI-5684's 3h per R1); noise classifier dropped health/metrics scrapes, background polling and static assets; HTTP surface recovered from server-span routes (spans-only; access logs unavailable).
queries: fetch spans,from:-24h | filter request.is_root_span==true and startsWith(service.name,'easytrade') | summarize count(),by:{service.name,span.name}  (easytrade entry surface; browser edge=frontendreverseproxy; backend svcs root separately via polling)
fetch logs,from:-24h | filter k8s.container.name=='istio-proxy' | summarize count()  (access-log probe -> unavailable, spans-only)

fetch spans,from:-24h | filter span.kind=='server' and service.name=='easytrade-frontendreverseproxy' and (span.name=='GET' or span.name=='POST') | summarize percentile(duration,50/95/99),count(),countIf(is_failed),by:{span.name}  (Viewer GET p95 366ms / Trader POST p95 63ms)
fetch spans,from:-24h | filter request.is_root_span==true and service.name=='easytrade-frontendreverseproxy' | summarize countDistinctApprox(trace.id)  (119,955 edge root traces)

fetch spans,from:-24h | filter (service.name=='easytrade-credit-card-order-service' and span.kind=='server' and startsWith(span.name,'POST')) or (service.name=='easytrade-engine' and span.kind=='server' and span.name=='POST') | summarize countDistinctApprox(trace.id)  (trader/terminal reach = 1,539 traces)

fetch spans,from:-24h | filter service.name=='easytrade-engine' and span.kind=='server' and span.name=='POST' | summarize percentile(duration,50/95/99),count()  (trade-engine POST p50 1.2ms p95 2.4ms p99 4.5ms)
fetch spans,from:-24h | filter request.is_root_span==true and service.name=='easytrade-frontendreverseproxy' | makeTimeseries count(),interval:1m  (arrival curve, 1438 bins, CoV 0.150)

fetch spans,from:-24h | filter span.kind=='server' and service.name=='easytrade-frontendreverseproxy' | summarize sum(duration),count()  (busy-integral 6.905e12 ns -> concurrency 0.080; rate 1.512 tps)

journeys.description: Viewer — browses prices, offers & account balances (read-only); reconstructed from the trace span-tree over a 24h window. Folds entry ops: viewer_browse_flow.
Trader — views account then executes a trade / credit-card order (write); reconstructed from the trace span-tree over a 24h window. Folds entry ops: trader_order_flow.
